title: Warm Silky Dutch Yeast Pancakes
description: A delicious and yeasty Dutch dish featuring pink food coloring, perfect for a weeknight treat, dairy-free friendly and served in a copper mug.

ingredients.name: non-dairy milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

ingredients.name: egg
ingredients.notes: or flax egg for vegan option

instructions: In a small bowl, combine yeast and non-dairy milk, stir to dissolve, and let sit for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the yeast mixture, egg, and pink food coloring to the dry ingredients, and stir until smooth.
Fold in the chopped blanched almonds.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes warm in a copper mug, garnished with additional blanched almonds if desired.
